text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kaya and Inori's word-linking battle rages on fiercely...
text_block_list.orig_text: カヤとイノリのしりとり合戦は熾烈を極めていた……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Y-you're not making this easy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なかなかやるですね……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: I'm impressed... you guys can take the heat...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イノリたちも
たいしたもんじゃねえか……

text_block_list.name: Draggo
text_block_list.text: Mirogh... rhee...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐも……
り……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
He spoke...? I think he just spoke!
\"Inori,\" he said! I heard him say my name!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しゃべった？　
今しゃべったですよ！？
イノリ、
って
あたしの名前を呼んだです！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Uhh... I guess it did sound a [i]little[/i] like that...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ
それっぽいといえばそれっぽい、
か……？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hee hee. You certainly have educated him well, Inori!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
イノリちゃんの教育の賜物かもね☆

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hey, what about me? You know me too, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
オレは？　
オレの事も分かるよな？

text_block_list.name: Draggo
text_block_list.text: Grrumgrraighhh mrragrhhhrragggihh.
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐもーりんぐもももも。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.orig_text: ん？

text_block_list.name: Draggo
text_block_list.text: Grrumgrraighhh mrragrhhhrragggihh.
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐもーりんぐもももも。

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: I suppose Inori's name is still all he can say.
text_block_list.orig_text: イノリちゃんの名前しか呼べないみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure he even said her name at all?
Just sounds like a bunch of \"grr\"s and \"mrr\"s to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとに名前呼んでるのか怪しくないか？
ぐもーりっていってるだけだぞコイツ。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're so hopeless!
Can't you tell he just said \"musclebrained battle addict\"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことないですよ！
ちゃんとカヤぴぃのことも
脳筋ケンカバカって言ってるです！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Ohhh...?
text_block_list.orig_text: ほう？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hee hee. You really have educated him well, Inori! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
イノリちゃんの教育の
賜物かもね〜☆

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I messed up...
Hey! Draggo! Apologize, quick!
Kaya-P's a big pushover really, so if you say sorry, it'll all be fine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ……
しまったです……
こら！　ドラちゃん！　
謝るです！
カヤぴぃはこう見えてチョロいから
今謝れば許してもらえるです！

text_block_list.name: Draggo
text_block_list.text: Graigh rorrighh.
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐもんももい。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, and you think I'm such a pushover
I'll take that comment lying down?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それを目の前で言われて許すほど、
オレはチョロくはねえぞ？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... At this point...
It's time to run! Draggo, follow me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ、
こうなったら……
逃げるですっ！　
ドラちゃん、
カモンでーす！

text_block_list.name: Draggo
text_block_list.text: Mrghhhhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐももーーーッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hold it, you two!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待て！　
コラーーッ！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hee hee. They're all such lovely friends~! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
すっかり仲良しさんだね〜☆

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And the sounds of rowdy \"grr\"ing and \"mrr\"ing
echoed throughout the wild jungle.
text_block_list.orig_text: 遺跡の森にぐももの声が鳴り響くのであった。
